data.name: Hasmuddin
data.gender_notes: Hasmuddin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hasmuddin is a Hindu name, derived from the Arabic words 'has', meaning 'gift', and 'muddin', meaning 'God'. The name signifies a gift from God, bestowed upon an individual as a blessing. The name Hasmuddin carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Hasmuddin usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hasmuddin is a divine name, believed to have spiritual significance and bestowed by the Almighty. It represents devotion, faith, and trust in the divine.
data.etymology: Hasmuddin belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasmuddin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
